ex.2: Book note: drawbacks of the IVSI — it shows a climb during a turn, and oscillates in turbulence.
ex.5: ROD ≈ 100 kt × 101.3 ft/min per kt × tan 3° ≈ 530 ft/min.
ex.1: Book note: During turns the piston is pulled out because of centrifugal force and the capsule contracts.
ex.9: Book note: After some time pressure will equalize in capsule and sealed casing.It will show zero in level, climb and descend.
ex.11: Book note: In Pressurized a/c, there is extra pressure coming in the static chamber, so, the capsule will contract and it will show rate of climb very high. This extra pressure will also effect rate of descend, which will be shown too low because of extra pressure. It will show rate of climb even in level flight.
ex.12: Book note: If there is a leak, pressure will quickly equalize with atmospheric pressure in the capsule, so, difference is zero.
ex.16: Book note: Error can be corrected with an adjusting screw on the front of the instrument.
